description: Finds products in Ramzii's catalog of Israeli supermarket online stores and gives today's price of each at every chain that sells it, with the cheapest chain, the date of the prices and the product's page on Ramzii. Example queries: "במבה", "קפה נמס עלית".

query.description: Product words in Hebrew, e.g. "במבה", "קוטג' 5%", "שמן זית".

name: search_products

data_date.description: Israeli day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the oldest price in the answer.

open_url.description: A www.ramzii.co.il link that opens this answer.

title: Search products and prices
